response.sql: WITH category_averages AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(ili.product_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_difference) AS mean_difference FROM category_averages) SELECT AVG(ca.avg_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(ca.avg_difference) AS average_difference, AVG(ca.avg_difference - om.mean_difference) AS average_excess FROM category_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om WHERE ca.avg_difference > om.mean_difference;
